explanation:
The central tree shrinks from 102 to 62 lines (39.2%) and from 7,207 to 4,803 characters (33.4%). Four peripherals give parsing, edit decisions, evidence handling, and consumer isolation their primary explanatory locations. [M] marks modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership, and [D] data dependency.

The critique's applicable layout recommendation is addressed by putting source directly beside its central branches, with no intervening diagram. Other peripherals also sit beside their attachment regions. Measured rectangles leave horizontal gaps of at least 14 characters and vertical gaps between stacked peripherals. All diagrams are connected, and edge endpoints identify relevant concepts. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Corrections grounded in diagramRevisionEditor.ts: resolve remaps active jump source anchors; target values pass through before the whole view is cloned. For patches with retainMappings, retention takes precedence over supplied mappings. Source-mapping and annotation edits preserve the numeric content revision while reviseDiagram issues a fresh revision identity. In diagram.ts, source-query helpers return existing references without independently freezing them. Its evidence-path check rejects leading '/' and '..' segments, but does not establish rejection of every absolute-path form.

Additional source-backed detail includes parser defaults and compatibility, WeakMap cache ownership, first-span identity anchors, source-binding hash inputs, and edit-range precedence. The content revision key id:revision is distinguished from the service revisionId.

The critique's proposed cross-point navigation and reconciliation are not adopted: other points' implementations and destination artifacts are outside the permitted evidence. Local issuance-to-retention and binding-to-view handoffs are explicit instead. Registry internals, interpreter internals, patch helpers, and durable adapters are not supplied; their behavior is not inferred. Flush-before-binding publication remains a documented contract, not demonstrated persistence behavior.

Immutable Diagram Revisions
|-- [M] Canonical payload shared by canvas, persistence, and agents
|   |-- Diagram holds content, sourceContext, and optional jumps/highlights
|   |-- diagramId identifies the service entity; revisionId identifies its revision
|   |-- id is the local content key; revision is the numeric content revision
|   |-- content.revisionId uses id:revision, independently of service revisionId
|   |-- buildDiagramContent: ASCII + kind + parser version -> canonical content
|   |   |-- [D] ASCII hash and content revision scope the parser's node identities
|   |   |-- Trees store nodes, hierarchy, roots, and fold ranges in content
|   |   `-- Diagrams keep ASCII and parser marker; derive nodes when requested
|   |-- diagramContentNodes exposes both forms through a common node shape
|   `-- validateDiagram rebuilds content using the stored parser version
|       |-- Require exact canonical content and sourceContext's matching hash
|       `-- Validate service identities, annotations, mappings, and evidence
|-- [M] Domain commands prepare edits; private issuance owns immutable records
|   |-- createDiagram -> editor.prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issue
|   |-- reviseDiagram supplies base revision and context bindings to the editor
|   |   |-- prepareEdit returns a payload plus old-to-new node correspondence
|   |   |-- Same payload object as base.diagram -> return existing revision
|   |   `-- Otherwise keep diagramId and assign a fresh revisionId
|   |-- Edit families: content patches/replacement, source mappings, annotations
|   |   `-- Content revision and issued revision identity can advance separately
|   |-- deriveDiagram prepares replacement content with selected source identities
|   |   |-- Each identity-source revision must belong to the base diagramId
|   |   `-- Derivation creates a child of base, even with identities from elsewhere
|   `-- [O] issueDiagramRevision assembles record, deep-freezes, then validates
|       |-- Record contains revision ID, diagram ID, payload, and nodeRefs
|       `-- A base supplies parentId; commands leave retention to their caller
|-- [D] Logical continuity bridges revision-specific content node identities
|   |-- nodeRefs maps each content node ID to its persistent logical node identity
|   |-- Issuance chooses explicit derived identity, then base match, then new UUID
|   |-- Editor correspondence connects prior content nodes to output content nodes
|   |   |-- Exact fallback requires unchanged ASCII and structure kind
|   |   `-- Explicit claims select output nodes using existing logical identities
|   `-- Conflicting correspondence cannot assign multiple identities to one node
|-- [M] Source context binds diagram content to pinned evidence
|   |-- sourceContext = contentHash + mappings + evidence + optional source binding
|   |-- [D] Mapping entityId selects evidence; sourceRangeIndex selects its range
|   |   `-- The optional sourceRangeId must agree with that selected range
|   |-- Binding identifies repository, corpus, and profile; ranges carry source text
|   `-- diagramSource exposes joined entries, selection results, and text search
|-- [C] submitDiagramEdit turns a generated candidate into a domain command
|   |-- Check requested base revision and local diagram identity before validation
|   |-- Context comes from base, then request context, then a constructed placeholder
|   |-- Validated candidate contributes correspondence; context supplies evidence
|   |-- Base plus edit ranges -> scopedReplacements -> reviseDiagram(patches)
|   |   `-- Preserve structure kind and return the replacement's output ranges
|   |-- Requested base without ranges -> reviseDiagram(replace)
|   `-- Otherwise createDiagram at numeric revision 0
|       `-- Existing edits request mapping retention when sourceMappings is absent
`-- [M] Runtime storage and externally supplied context bindings
    |-- Stored command wrappers call domain commands, then retainDiagramRevision
    |-- [O] Retention imports into the registry and returns its held revision object
    |   `-- get retrieves revisions; list exposes frozen ancestry summaries
    |-- Editor receives context -> local diagram -> revision bindings from outside
    |   `-- Canvas history supplies bindings according to the editor's contract
    |-- [C] resolve follows a binding and returns a structured-cloned DiagramView
    |   `-- Consumer node identities are logical; canonical payload stays private
    |-- merge compares baseline/current bindings before accepting proposed bindings
    |   `-- Any difference raises MERGE_REQUIRED; automatic merge is unimplemented
    `-- Durable adapters must flush revisions before publishing bindings
        `-- This is the store's stated contract; adapter code is outside the inputs

Parser compatibility and derived-node ownership
|-- [D] New content defaults: tree = ascii-tree-2; diagram = ascii-graph-1
|   |-- Accept ascii-tree-1 for older trees; reject versions of the wrong kind
|   `-- An unversioned stored diagram rebuilds with legacy-diagram
|-- [C] Tree parser calls the shared interpreter with zero tolerances
|   |-- Tree dialect; separate continuations; no repairs
|   `-- Fold range ends before next peer/ancestor-level node, or at EOF
|-- [C] diagramContentNodes dispatch
|   |-- Tree: Object.values of stored nodes; bypass derived-node cache
|   |-- Graph: parseAsciiGraph boxes; local ID uses first text span line/column
|   |   `-- lines[] preserves all spans; line/startColumn/endColumn anchor only first
|   `-- Legacy: mixed interpreter; preserve scoped interpreter IDs
|-- [O] Derived diagram nodes are deep-frozen and cached in a private WeakMap
|   `-- Key is the content object; repeated access reuses the cached node array
|-- [C] visibleContentLines excludes stored fold intervals for collapsed trees
|   `-- Unknown tree node ID raises STALE_CONTENT_NODE; non-trees show all lines
`-- Content acceptance: 1-20000 printable ASCII characters with LF newlines
    `-- Blank exception: diagram with >1 equal-width, nonempty, all-space lines

Edit decisions and logical identity claims
|-- [C] source-mappings: expected hash mismatch -> CONTENT_HASH_CONFLICT
|   `-- Clone mappings/evidence; replace binding only when supplied
|-- [C] patch / patches delegate to patchDiagramRanges
|   |-- Explicit correspondence refines its node map and rebases old highlights
|   |-- patches + retainMappings -> retainSourceMappings using lineAfter
|   `-- Otherwise supplied mappings use prior evidence and binding
|-- [C] replace constructs content at before.revision + 1
|   |-- Rebase old jumps and highlights when present
|   `-- Optional retention replaces the constructed mappings
|-- [D] Source-mapping and annotation edits preserve numeric content revision
|   `-- They create new payload objects, so reviseDiagram issues new revision IDs
|-- [D] Exact fallback: after unchanged ASCII/kind gate, match unique geometry
|   `-- Key = line + start/end columns + label; no heuristic identity matching
|-- [C] Editor's private correspondence checks each logical-ref -> line claim
|   |-- Logical ref must exist in base.nodeRefs; output line must be an integer
|   |-- Exactly one output node must start on that line
|   |-- Reject disagreement with an already inferred match
|   `-- Reject multiple old nodes mapping to the same output node
|-- [C] deriveDiagram builds allowed refs from supplied identity-source revisions
|   |-- Base refs also pass through the editor's correspondence checks
|   `-- Every claimed ref must be allowed and select one unclaimed output node
`-- [O] Issuance reverses old-to-new correspondence to look up base.nodeRefs
    `-- Identity sources affect nodeRefs; the base alone determines parentId

Evidence integrity and generated scope decisions
|-- [M] validateDiagram checks binding and pinned evidence
|   |-- Binding root starts with '/' or a drive-letter absolute-path prefix
|   |-- source-code pairs with git-worktree; document with filesystem-documents
|   |-- Evidence key equals entry.id; nonempty sourceId agrees if binding exists
|   |-- Range path rejects leading '/' and any '..' path segment
|   |   `-- This check alone does not reject a Windows drive-letter absolute path
|   `-- Positive ordered line bounds; originalLines has matching count of strings
|-- [D] sourceBindingFromLocation hashes corpus kind + ':' + root
|   `-- sourceId uses the first 24 hash characters; revision is outside that hash
|-- [M] Source-query helpers return existing context/mapping/evidence references
|   |-- They do not themselves clone or freeze those referenced values
|   `-- Search lowercases entityId, label, range path, and symbol
`-- [C] submitDiagramEdit: candidate validation precedes scope transformation
    |-- New diagram with replacementRanges is rejected
    |-- Nonempty editRanges takes precedence over singular editRange
    |-- Clean nodeCorrespondence overrides caller claims with the same key
    |-- Scoped edits drop mappings whose anchor line is inside replaced ranges
    |   |-- Outside anchors shift by size deltas of preceding replacements
    |   `-- Add candidate mappings inside output ranges, excluding retained IDs
    `-- Dispatch patches with retainMappings = !request.sourceMappings
        |-- True: editor retention takes precedence over the supplied mappings
        `-- False: the assembled mappings reach the editor's supplied-mapping branch

Retention checks and consumer isolation
|-- [C] retainDiagramRevision -> importDiagramRevision -> registry.register
|   |-- Each current content node needs a nonempty string logical ref
|   |-- Those refs must be unique across current nodes
|   `-- Read back via registry.get; return held objects with result metadata
|-- [O] list freezes each {id, diagramId, parentId} summary and the array
|-- [C] Editor's private lookup follows context binding to a revision
|   `-- Missing revision or mismatched local diagram ID -> Unknown diagram
`-- [C] resolve builds the consumer view
    |-- Translate node id, parentId, and childIds through nodeRefs
    |-- Include active jumps; remove source revisionId and contentHash
    |   `-- Remap source.contentNodeId; target value passes through unchanged
    `-- structuredClone includes nodes, sourceContext, and jump targets
        `-- Consumer mutations cannot change the canonical revision payload
